methodologyNote: A third check (layout stability) is part of the site's real 4-check framework but is excluded from this published dataset: it requires a real browser (Lighthouse) to measure honestly, and the automated, at-scale method used for this study produced contradictory results in two independent batches (100% pass in one, 100% fail in another) that reflect an artifact of HTML-to-text conversion, not real page behavior. Figures here cover the 3 checks reliably measurable at this scale.
